description: Ranking of ALL tested French online stores in one sector, best score first. Use it when the user wants the best stores of a sector as a whole (for example the best beauty stores for an AI agent). To filter by proven facts such as guest checkout, use trouver_marchands; for the details of one store, consulter_marchand. Returns: secteur and marchands, a list of every ranked store (30 to 70 per sector) with rang, ex_aequo (equal scores share a rank, then alphabetical order), domaine, nom, note out of 100, nombre_avis, dernier_test, test_ancien and page. Sectors: beaute, mode, maison, sport, epicerie, enfant, animalerie, bijoux, bricolage, high-tech. Unknown sector: error result listing the valid ones.

langue.description: Language of the page links and, for consulter_marchand, of the summary sentence: fr (default) or en. Data fields are the same in both.
